name: Misar.Blog MCP Server
description: Publish and manage blog posts, articles, and series on Misar.Blog directly from your AI agent. Features 23 tools: create/publish articles, manage series, query analytics, handle comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers, and AI-assisted content generation.

skills.name: Blog content publishing
examples: Draft an article about our Q3 launch and save it as a draft for review.
Publish the onboarding guide and add it to the Getting Started series.
How did the blog perform over the last 30 days?
skills.description: Publish and manage blog posts, articles, and series on Misar.Blog directly from your AI agent. Features 23 tools: create/publish articles, manage series, query analytics, handle comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers, and AI-assisted content generation. Exposed as 23 MCP tools; every tool carries behavioural annotations describing whether it reads, writes, or is destructive.

apiKey.description: Misar.Blog API key (prefix mbk_), sent as a bearer token or as ?apiKey=. Also readable from MISARBLOG_API_KEY on the stdio server. Discovery methods answer without it; every tool call requires it.
